cost: Build O(n log² n), O(n) resident storage; query O(n) worst time with O(log n) recursion. Re-sorting each subproblem is explicit; no worst-case sublinear nearest-neighbor claim.
forward: Build recursively at alternating-axis medians, ordered by coordinate then original index. For query q visit the near child first and compare (squared distance,index); visit the far child when squared split-plane distance <= current minimum. Return (index,distance), or None iff no points.
inverse: Typed behavior complement, ambiguous reverse reconstruction and specializations in model.md
limitations: Exact bounded APIs only. No generic 1/2/5/10% accuracy surrogate is supported. Finite tests do not prove universal correctness or runtime gains. Standard Vec/Box/BTreeMap allocation failure may abort or panic; allocator refusal is not injected. No callbacks, I/O or concurrency effects.
Partial syntax only; no semantic proof
